verdict.rationale: Marqeta is a payments API platform that ships its own MCP server for AI agents to consume its tools (docs-11, docs-23, probe-4) — the reverse relationship. There is no evidence Marqeta itself acts as an MCP client/host that plugs in external MCP servers to use their tools, and as a payments platform (not an agent or IDE), this client-side capability is not a fair axis for this product category.
